name: socket
title: http.socket
lead: Opens a WebSocket (`ws` or `wss`) and keeps it open: when the connection ends, the engine dials again. `on_message` gets each message on a tick.
signature: http.socket(url: string, options: {headers: {[string]: string }?, on_message: (message: SocketMessage) -> ()}) → Socket

usedIn.quote: `http.socket` opens a WebSocket and keeps it open. Use it for what a server
